title: Close G1: native Target and minimal delivery control loop
intent: Freeze the native Workspace-scoped Target model, make Target creation conversation-first and human-confirmed, and establish the minimal native WorkGraph, Stage, Attention, and Run loop.
scope: Complete items 1, 2, and 3 for G1 without claiming the later Submission, Evidence, Review, Acceptance, or external delivery loop.
non_goals: Implement G2 Run completion, Submission, Artifact, Evidence, DeliveryReview, or Acceptance commands
Remove inherited Project, Issue, Case, Heartbeat, adapter, plugin, or compatibility storage
Map compatibility Project, Issue, Case, Artifact, or Heartbeat facts into native Target or Run facts
Publish, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without explicit user approval
acceptance_criteria: Target belongs directly to Workspace, may reference a native Collection, and has no Project, Case, Issue, or compatibility projection authority.
Ordinary Conversation messages create neither TargetCreationDraft nor Target; an explicit source message creates an immutable, versioned draft.
Only an authorized human can confirm a complete draft; retries use the same deterministic idempotency key and return the original Target, TargetRevision, WorkGraph, and GraphRevision identities.
CreateTarget atomically creates Target, immutable TargetRevision, empty WorkGraph, draft GraphRevision, audit, outbox, and command receipt facts.
Graph revisions validate target revision binding, node kinds, stages, dependencies, completion definitions, and acyclicity; activation is transactional and idempotent.
Run creation accepts only a ready agent or integration node on the active graph revision, records native Run facts, advances the node, and rejects idempotency conflicts.
TargetReadModel and Target Workbench expose native Stage, Work, Attention, Run, and Timeline facts or honest empty sets without reading compatibility facts.
Database, shared, Go, server, OpenAPI, UI, tests, canonical docs, and delivery evidence remain synchronized; verification gaps are reported truthfully.
